title: Approved Too Late: Verdict Staleness in LLM-Guarded Self-Adaptive Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.26306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A large language model (LLM) guardrail for a self-adaptive system (SAS) may issue an approval that is correct at check time but stale by actuation. This creates an Execute-stage time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) hazard. We study verdict freshness: whether a guardrail verdict remains valid when used. We distinguish three quantities that answer different questions: all-candidate verdict change under fixed-action replay, oracle-labeled approval expiry on recorded closed-loop trajectories, and judge-conditioned use-time invalidity. Across five reproducible SAS environments, all-candidate verdict-change rates span 5.3-48.4% at a common replay shift of eight simulator steps. We introduce the Freshness-Bounded Shield (FBS), which estimates each approval's validity horizon from its safe-side margin and recent feature volatility, without an explicit plant-dynamics model. translated_title: 批准过迟：大语言模型守护的自适应系统中的判决时效性问题
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）作为自适应系统（SAS）的守护机制，可能在检查时正确但在执行时已过时的批准，这造成了执行阶段的时间检查到时间使用（TOCTOU）危险。我们研究了判决新鲜度问题：即守护判决在使用时是否仍然有效。我们区分了三个不同问题的量：固定动作重放下的全候选判决变化、记录闭环轨迹上的神谕标签批准过期、以及法官条件下的使用时效无效性。在五个可复现的SAS环境中，在常见的八个模拟器步骤重放偏移下，全候选判决变化率范围在5.3%到48.4%之间。我们引入了新鲜度边界防护（FBS），它从安全侧边距和最近特征波动性估计每个批准的时效范围，无需显式植物动力学模型。使用工件中记录的固定设置，FBS降低了神谕标签（的过期情况）。
tldr: 本文研究了LLM守护的自适应系统中判决过时问题，并提出一种无需植物动力学模型的新鲜度边界防护（FBS）方法，有效减少执行时的TOCTOU风险。
en_tdlr: This paper studies verdict staleness in LLM-guarded self-adaptive systems and proposes a Freshness-Bounded Shield (FBS) method that estimates approval validity without explicit plant-dynamics models, reducing TOCTOU hazards at execution time.
